{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in 'arm' and 'severity' to confirm the groups
print("Unique arms:", trial_df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique severities:", trial_df['severity'].unique())

# Check for any missing values
print("Missing values in 'responded':", trial_df['responded'].isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of 'responded' in the CONTROL-arm and MODERATE-severity group
control_mod = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

print("Total patients in control, moderate:", len(control_mod))
print("Responded (1) in control, moderate:", control_mod['responded'].sum())

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = control_mod['responded'].mean()

fraction_responded"}
